description: This file defines functions and data types for parsing, handling, and extracting data from JSON objects using the cJSON library. It provides functions for reading JSON files, parsing JSON strings, retrieving JSON items and values, managing JSON objects, and checking JSON array properties. Essentially, it offers utilities for JSON manipulation in C/C++ projects.

methods.name: SetJsonVars
methods.description: Reads a JSON file, optionally writes name=value pairs to an output file, and can set environment variables based on the JSON content.

methods.name: ParseJsonStr
methods.description: Parses a JSON string and returns a cJSON object pointer representing the JSON data.

methods.name: FreeJson
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a JSON object created by ParseJsonStr.

methods.name: GetJsonItem
methods.description: Retrieves a JSON object within a larger JSON structure based on a search key.

methods.name: GetJsonValFromString
methods.description: Extracts a value from a JSON string corresponding to a given key.

methods.name: GetJsonVal
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key from a JSON object.

methods.name: GetJsonValContainingFromString
methods.description: Searches a JSON string for a key that contains the specified search string, similar to grep.

methods.name: GetJsonValContaining
methods.description: Searches within a JSON object for a key containing a specified substring and retrieves its value.

methods.name: GetJson
methods.description: Reads a JSON file and returns its contents as a dynamically allocated string.

methods.name: IsJsonArray
methods.description: Checks if a JSON object is an array.

methods.name: GetJsonArraySize
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in a JSON array.

methods.name: GetJsonArrayItem
methods.description: Retrieves a specific item from a JSON array by index.
